## Description

Ranks firms by dividends plus net share repurchases (and sometimes net debt paydown) relative to market capitalization.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon equity selection where capital return reflects shareholder-friendly capital allocation.

## Vehicles

Equity income, quality/value and multi-factor portfolios.

## Required data

Point-in-time dividends, buybacks/issuance, debt changes, market capitalization, fundamentals and corporate actions.

## Caveats

Buybacks must be measured net of issuance and compensation dilution; buyback announcements differ from completed repurchases.
